According to the data definitions for `repeat_customers` and `customers_distinct` in `governed.orders_by_period`, distinct customer counts and repeat customer metrics are non-additive and do not have an additive daily breakdown. They can only be retrieved for standard pre-computed grains (single day, whole ISO week starting Monday, or whole calendar month). Consequently, repeat purchase rate for an arbitrary multi-day span (10 days) is not available.

The governed tables do not define a direct "cart abandonment rate" metric. In the governed semantic layer, site funnel conversion is tracked via **Cart-to-checkout rate** (`cart_to_checkout_rate`), defined in `governed.customer_actions_by_period`. Furthermore, `cart_to_checkout_rate` is a non-additive metric with no additive formula across custom date spans that do not align with a single predefined day, ISO week (Monday–Sunday), or calendar month. Because the requested period (**20 September to 3 October 2026**, a 14-day arbitrary span) is not a single calendar day, ISO week, or calendar month, the governed tables cannot answer for this exact custom span.

                        WHEN metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-09-27' THEN 'week_21'

   GROUP BY campaign__channel,

          SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE

FROM ad_spend AS s

              WHEN metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-09-27' THEN '2026-09-21'

   WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY channel,
            week_start),

  (SELECT campaign__channel AS channel,
          CASE
              WHEN metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20' THEN '2026-09-14'
              WHEN metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-09-27' THEN '2026-09-21'
          END AS week_start,

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`governed`.`bookings_daily`
   WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY channel,
            week_start),
     combined AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.week_start, b.week_start) AS week_start,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), NULLIF(COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0), 0)) AS cost_per_booking_eur
   FROM spend AS s
   FULL OUTER JOIN bookings AS b ON s.channel = b.channel
   AND s.week_start = b.week_start),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN cost_per_booking_eur
              END) AS cpb_week_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking_eur
              END) AS cpb_week_sep_21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_week_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_week_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_week_sep_21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_week_sep_21
   FROM combined
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,

       cpb_week_sep_21,

       spend_week_sep_14,
       bookings_week_sep_14,
       spend_week_sep_21,
       bookings_week_sep_21
FROM pivoted
